gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-gidole: Heavy letters bent like straw, their terminals curling round until they nearly touch the stem, give Plakkaat its loud tone. Gidole handles the finer job, its sans terminals staying apart like open scissor blades.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-golos-text: Terminals sweep around until they nearly touch the stem, giving Plakkaat heavy letters like bent straw. Golos Text stays open in reply, its sans-serif letters tall in the line and its s widely parted.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-hedvig-letters-sa: Approachable Hedvig Letters Sans meets heavy, bent-straw Plakkaat. The body's c gapes wide and its small letters stand almost as tall as capitals, while Plakkaat curls its terminals nearly shut.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-heebo: Heebo stands tall and open, its curves stopping short instead of closing in on themselves. And beside heavy Plakkaat, whose terminals curl nearly shut, that openness becomes a clear second voice.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-hind-guntur: Modern in feel, Hind Guntur leaves wide openings between curve ends and stems, without any thick-thin shift. Closed Plakkaat meets open type, and that tension is the whole appeal.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-hind-madurai: Hind Madurai opens its s wide at both ends, and its lowercase fills the line almost like capitals do. Next to closed, heavy Plakkaat, that openness is the draw.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-hind-mysuru: Hind Mysuru reads straight and unfussy, with no calligraphic thinning. Plakkaat does heavy, closed statements best, while the body's ajar a and tall-topped lowercase do the quieter work plainly.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-hind-siliguri: Hind Siliguri hums along at a flat constant line weight, its rounds gapping like a cracked bangle. Hind Siliguri keeps its gaps open where closed, heavy Plakkaat nearly seals its curls.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-hind-vadodara: Hind Vadodara reads clean and spacious, with wide gaps in its rounded letters and big open-looking e and a. Heavy, closed Plakkaat gives that openness something firm to push against.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-huninn: Huninn reads crisp and modern, with lowercase rising close to cap height. Line after line, its s terminals hold back from the body and crossbars match their stems, so reading moves smoothly below heavy Plakkaat.
